nfl2k5tool_dart (tools\nfl2k5-save-converter.exe)
https://github.com/BAD-AL/nfl2k5tool_dart

Created by BAD-AL. NFL2K5-PC uses it to convert PS2 (.max/.psu) and Xbox
saves dropped into saves\import. Built by tools\build-save-converter.ps1 from
upstream revision e3afeece61896380a95e506ab43ae1abda0ae8a5 with
tools\nfl2k5tool-name-pool.patch applied. All credit for the save format work
belongs to its author.
